item.description:
New in 0.1.7

Heads up, invite codes are retired. TimeCal now unlocks with a license key from Polar. On first launch after this update you will see the unlock screen; paste the key from your Polar email and you are back in. Beta testers get their key from the free beta link, the same key the paid version uses. Two Macs per key.

  • The unlock screen. Paste your key, or use the Buy and Lost your key links right there. Until a key is entered TimeCal opens nothing: no calendars are read, no calendar permission is asked for.
  • Works offline. Once a key is activated TimeCal never needs the network to open. It checks in quietly, at most once a day, and a failed check changes nothing. Only a revoked key ever locks the app, and even then not until the next launch, with a notice first.
  • Settings, License. See who the license belongs to, when this Mac was activated, and the last check. Deactivate this Mac to move the license to another one, or manage devices from your Polar purchases.
  • About shows the tail of your key, handy in a support email.

Feedback

Send anything, bugs, ideas, confusion, to evan@trytimecal.com.
